title: Jewelry Appraisal Lead Generation
description: CaratBase sends leads to independent jewelers, estate buyers and appraisers from people looking to sell gold or get an appraisal. First 3 free, then $40.
html:
Jewelry Appraisal Lead Generation

CaratBase sends leads to independent jewelers, estate buyers, and appraisers who want customers looking to sell gold, get an appraisal, or purchase an engagement ring. The first 3 leads are free, then $40 per accepted lead.

What You Receive

  • Leads – People who want an appraisal or gold-sale service.
  • Where – Starting in Atlanta, with other metros planned.
  • Optional Pro website widget – $12/month.

Pricing

  • First 3 leads: free.
  • Subsequent leads: $40 per accepted lead.
  • Pro website widget (optional): $12/month.

FAQ

What is the cost after the free leads? Each accepted lead costs $40. The optional Pro website widget is $12/month.

Can I use CaratBase outside of Atlanta? CaratBase is starting in Atlanta and plans to expand to other metros.

Next Step

Learn more at caratbase.com.
